steps.action: Revoke the production key that was read by the agent immediately in the secrets manager or provider console.
steps.quote: Revoke the exposed key immediately in the secrets manager or the provider's console.

steps.action: Create a replacement production key restricted to the required purpose, preferably read-only and short-lived.
steps.quote: Issue a new key limited to the intended use, read-only if possible, with a short lifetime.

steps.action: Update the affected production services to use the new key, then verify they still work.
steps.quote: Update the services that used the old key, then check that they work.

steps.action: Remove the exposed secret from .env.prod and any repository or agent workspace copies.
steps.quote: Remove the secret from every file of the repository and of the agents' workspace, .env files included.
